507 18/8/16 O.U.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
August 8th 1913
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
The Admiralty Office in Shanghai has been
restored with Admiral Lee Thin San? in charge.
An exhibition of curios will take place at Kin
Yui Soo 碧雲轩 outside South Gate on 11th and 12th inst,
the profits of which will go to the funds of the
City Volunteers.
The body of a strangling female about 15 years of age
was found in a waste piece of ground near To Sing Woo
Park outside the West Gate on 8th inst. The body
was wrapped up in a cotton quilt. Enquiries showed
that it had been deposited by a ricksha coolie
where it was found.
It is reported that Hon Hwo a rebel leader
living at No.10 Zang Woo Li (庄吴里) brought with
him about eight hundred ex-soldiers in his employment
and he has given them no pay for the past fortnight.
Previously they were paid every week.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmuuustina
Chief Detective Inspector.

9/8 (批)
Captain Superintendent of Police.

507 18/8/16 O.U.
上海工部局。
1913年8月8日
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：
上海海军署已恢复运作，由李鼎新（Lee Thin San?）海军上将负责。
本月11日及12日，将在南门外碧雲轩（Kin Yui Soo）举行古玩展览，所得利润将捐入市义勇队基金。
本月8日，在西门外多辛坞（To Sing Woo）公园附近的一块荒地上，发现一具约15岁被勒死的女性尸体。尸体用棉絮包裹。经查，系由一名人力车夫放置于该处。
据悉，叛军首领洪浩（Hon Hwo，音译）居住于庄吴里10号，其雇佣了约八百名退伍士兵，且在过去两周内未向他们发放薪饷。此前，这些士兵每周领取薪饷。

您顺从的仆人，
mmmuuustina
总探长。

9/8 （批注）
警务处总监。
